instruccions.titol:
How to use the calculator?
 REMEMBER TO HAVE A RECENT BILL HANDY
instruccions.pas1_desc: Select whether it’s for your Home or Business. This will help us make more accurate calculations.
instruccions.pas2_desc:
Enter your energy consumption, contracted power, and the amounts you’ve paid for each.
 If you don’t know these figures, we can still estimate your savings using just the amounts you’ve paid for both.
instruccions.pas3_desc: We’ll calculate your estimated savings percentage. Please keep in mind that the results are based on the information currently available and do not include taxes or other charges, such as associated services, etc..
instruccions.consell: Tip: You can find your energy consumption total or per period and the power term on the second page of your last bill.
